people.bio: With 10 years of experience in the tech industry, Thomas is passionate about building efficient processes and procedures that help teams work smarter and businesses run better. He enjoys bringing structure to challenges, creating solutions, and finding ways to continually improve. Outside of work, he is a proud husband to his wife, Sydnee, and dad to his two kids, Harper and Hattie. Family is everything, and he loves spending time with them whenever he's not working on making things better behind the scenes.
